script.text: A bench by the lake, late afternoon. ANUDI laughs, her phone face-down on the bench between her and DASUN.
Her phone buzzes on the bench. The screen lights: THATHTHA.
Anudi glances at it, still smiling, and answers.
She ends the call and puts the phone face-down on the bench.
She picks up her bag and walks out. Dasun watches her go.

lines.speaker: Father (on the phone)
lines.text: දුවේ, ඔයාගේ විවාහය ගැන අපි තීරණය කළා.

treatment.logline: A call from her father decides Anudi's marriage and ends an easy afternoon on a lakeside bench.
treatment.approach: Wide and still for the ease, closer and longer lenses as the call lands, a held wide for the exit.

colour_script.light: low late-afternoon sun from the left

treatment.geography: Anudi frame left on the bench, Dasun frame right, the lake behind; the camera stays on the path side of the bench.
treatment.key_image: The phone face-down on the bench in the gap between them.
advice: The call's words are heard over her face; the phone's screen is never read.

shots.why: The world: the bench small against the lake, the two of them at ease.
